title: Censys Collections
description: The Censys Collections connector ingests analyst-curated threat collections from Censys into OpenCTI as observables and indicators. For each asset (host IP, X.509 certificate, web property domain) in a collection, the connector creates the corresponding OpenCTI observable, auto-generates a linked indicator for enterprise blocking, attaches any associated malware families, threat-actor groups, or CVE vulnerabilities as relationships, and adds an external reference back to the Censys collection for analyst drill-down.
short_description: Ingests Censys analyst collections into OpenCTI as observables and indicators, with malware/threat-actor/CVE relationships and Censys collection external references.
